<p>Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations.</p>
<p>Total net sales decreased 3% to $383,285 million during 2023. Research and development expense increased 14% to $29,915 million, driven primarily by an increase in headcount-related expenses and product development engineering costs.</p>
<p>Item 8. Financial Statements and Supplementary Data.</p>

<p>Item 1A. Risk Factors. The Company's business is subject to intense competition across all markets for its products and services, characterised by aggressive price competition and rapid technological advances.</p>
